recalibration: We expected people arriving from a code editor. Most arrive from search and have never opened your docs. We updated what we expect them to do, and it changed two of the calls above.

rows.headline: People can't send team invites
rows.context: The button does nothing — the request behind it fails every time. Most press it three times, then leave. Started the day PR #482 shipped.

rows.headline: The card form never appears on Safari
rows.context: People choose a plan and stop. The field is never drawn for them, so there is nothing to fill in.

rows.headline: Renaming a workspace looks like it failed
rows.context: It saves, and nothing on the screen says so, so people do it again.

rows.headline: The export menu offers a format that does not exist
rows.context: Choosing it returns people to where they started, with no message.

rows.headline: People open Billing and leave without choosing
rows.context: They scroll the plan list twice, then go.
rows.aside: We can show you what they did; we can't tell you why.

rows.headline: People read the pricing page and leave
rows.context: Over a minute on the page, and no clicks at all.
rows.aside: Nothing broke — as far as we can tell, they decided against it.
